newsitem.title: USA: Allmerica sees reserves affecting net.
newsitem.headline: Allmerica sees reserves affecting net.

text.p: Allmerica Financial Corp said on Wednesday that its future earnings could be hurt by reduced funds after the company paid its claims at its Hanover property and casualty insurance unit.
The insurance and financial services company said its loss reserves are conservatively stated, but Hanover had $12.9 million left after paying claims in the third quarter of 1996.
This is a decrease from $25.6 million in last year's third quarter, the company said.
An Allmerica spokeswoman said the reserves after the claims are paid are about five percent of the total set aside to pay claims, but in the past year the company had about six or seven percent.
(In news alert preceding story, company corrects status of reserves.)
